1. Home

Ideas for a buildable home

Design inspiration grounded in planning, materials, and daily use.

Explore architectural directions for the spaces and systems RT Signature Homes plans and builds. Each gallery connects visual ideas with the decisions that shape a successful residential project.

Discuss your project Explore services
Call (206) 407-6291

Whole-Home Remodeling

Whole-Home Design Ideas

A whole-home renovation works best when circulation, structure, lighting, storage, and finish selections are considered as one system. These ideas show how individual rooms can share a consistent architectural language without becoming repetitive.

Explore the gallery

Kitchen Remodeling

Kitchen Design Ideas

The strongest kitchens balance work zones, circulation, storage, daylight, task lighting, and materials that can handle daily use. This gallery focuses on combinations that feel refined without sacrificing function.

Explore the gallery

Flooring Installation & Refinishing

Flooring & Finish Palette Ideas

Flooring carries color, texture, sound, and visual continuity through the home. These palettes explore how wood, resilient products, tile, paint, and millwork can support one another.

Explore the gallery

Interior Painting

Interior Color & Paint Ideas

Paint changes with daylight, artificial light, adjacent materials, and sheen. This gallery explores warm, architectural palettes and the preparation details that make the finished work feel precise.

Explore the gallery

Bathroom Remodeling

Bathroom Design Ideas

A refined bathroom depends on careful relationships between waterproofing, drainage, tile, fixtures, ventilation, lighting, storage, and clearances. These ideas keep performance and comfort at the center.

Explore the gallery

Home Additions

Home Addition Design Ideas

An addition should improve the existing home rather than feel attached to it. These ideas focus on massing, rooflines, openings, circulation, daylight, and material transitions between old and new.

Explore the gallery

ADU Design & Construction

ADU Design Ideas

A successful ADU makes limited area feel deliberate. These ideas explore compact planning, daylight, privacy, storage, utilities, access, and a respectful relationship to the primary home.

Explore the gallery

Exterior Remodeling

Exterior Remodeling Ideas

Exterior work performs best when roofing, siding, openings, flashing, drainage, and outdoor living areas are treated as one weather-protection system. These ideas balance durability and curb appeal.

Explore the gallery

Start a practical conversation

Bring your ideas into one practical conversation.

Share the spaces, materials, and priorities that are shaping your project.
